title: Monotonicity of uniform probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $P$ and $Q$ be predicates on $\Omega$ such that every element satisfying $P$ also satisfies $Q$. Then the uniform probability that $P$ holds is at most the uniform probability that $Q$ holds.
